findings.location: ## Definition, paragraph beginning “For an adapted continuous candidate X” and the displayed vector Itô equation
findings.evidence: The version observed during review used b(s,X_s) and σ(s,X_s) in the drift and localized Itô integrals but did not declare or establish their measurability classes. Its then-declared dependency def-progressively-measurable-and-predictable-process gives predictable ⇒ progressive, not adapted-continuous ⇒ predictable/progressive; the localized Itô interface requires predictable diffusion integrands. The SDE definition normalizes continuous representatives to be everywhere continuous and adapted. The local published lemma lem-adapted-continuous-processes-are-progressively-measurable supplies the adapted-continuous result; Borel coefficient composition must also be identified. A later read found that the current source now declares the lemma in deps. The source changed after review, and no immutable pre-reader snapshot binds the earlier bytes, so this historical finding does not claim the current bytes remain defective.
